before: Confirm irrigation system pressure and flow before sunset.
Stage thermometers in lowest (cold-air pooling) blocks.
Prepare to activate frost protection before temperatures reach 32°F.
during_irrigation_available: Start sprinklers before temperatures drop below 32°F.
Maintain continuous water application throughout the freeze period.
during_no_irrigation: Closely monitor orchard temperature during the risk window.
Prioritize protection for younger or most vulnerable blocks if limited tools available.
after: Do not shut off irrigation until temperatures safely rise above freezing and ice begins melting.
Inspect blossoms or small nutlets for browning/black centers (ovary damage).
Document affected blocks for yield projection adjustments.

notes: Almond trees are most sensitive to freezing temperatures during bloom and post-petal fall.
Temperatures of 27–28°F for 30 minutes or more can result in significant crop loss.
Duration of freezing temperatures is as critical as minimum temperature.
Sprinkler irrigation protects blossoms by releasing heat during water freezing.
